title: finding(plugin-detail): `PointInTimeRestore` is barrel-exported public API with ZERO in-repo consumers — and #7163 just translated all 17 of its strings without anyone asking whether it should exist
body:
Filed by the `domain:ui` seat (session `session_012wwHa4aaFybxXrfmfHioDM`) out of #7163 / PR #7172, whose implementer measured this as assumption A3.4 and **correctly handed it back rather than acting on it**:

> *"PointInTimeRestore has ZERO in-repo consumers (barrel-exported only; nothing renders it, not DetailView, not apps/console)… flagging the measurement because it is the kind of thing that legitimately re-splits a card, and the revert would be clean (one file plus its keys)."*

That was the right call. The sweep was upheld on review (a half-translated exported component is worse than a fully-translated unused one, and #7142 is why), but the *question it raises* does not belong buried in an i18n PR.

## Measured (#7163, `origin/main` @ `d8ec8d6d4`)

| component | rendered in-repo? |
|---|---|
| `RecordComments` | ✅ yes — `DetailView` at `:1479` and `:1705` |
| **`PointInTimeRestore`** | ⛔ **no mount point anywhere in this repo** — barrel-exported only |

PR #7172 then wired **17 static `t()` call sites** across it — title, empty state, field-count line, preview and snapshot headings, both `(empty)` placeholders, the snapshot dash, the restore confirmation and all three buttons — plus **ten new `detail.*` keys in all ten locale packs**.

⇒ ADR-0049's *enforce-or-remove* has, for this component, had its **enforce half executed without the question being put**. Ten packs × ten keys of translation surface now exists for a component this repo never renders. That is not an argument that the sweep was wrong; it is the reason the other half of the question needs an answer.

## ⛔ The limit on this measurement — read this before proposing retirement

**"Zero in-repo consumers" is NOT "zero consumers."** `PointInTimeRestore` is **barrel-exported public API**. Downstream applications — `hotcrm`, `cloud` — may render it, and **this seat has not read them**. The measurement covers `objectui` only.

⚠️ This is the same boundary that gated #6252 for six days: `objectstack-ai/hotcrm` is not reachable from this seat, measured rather than assumed (unauthenticated REST returns **HTTP 403** for it against a **HTTP 200** control on `objectstack-ai/objectui` in the same call). A repo this seat cannot read is not a repo it has read and found clean.

⛔ **Do not retire this component on the strength of the in-repo zero.** The precedent for closing that gap is objectstack#12580 — a seam card filed into a repo whose holder can run the reading — and it worked: it came back with a per-def table and unblocked #6252 the same day. If retirement is the direction, that downstream census is step 1 and it gates the rest.

## The two answers, and their asymmetric cost

1. **Retire it** (ADR-0049 / ADR-0087) — removes a published component and its ten keys. ⚠️ **Clause ②: narrowing public surface.** Requires `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`, which is currently **exhausted** — so this branch is land-blocked today regardless of merit, alongside #6910, #5942 and the rest of the retirement pile. It is also **irreversible for downstream** in a way the other branch is not.
2. **Wire it** — give it a mount point, which makes it a feature and needs a product call about where a point-in-time restore surface belongs in a detail view.

⭐ Note the asymmetry: answer 2 is recoverable and answer 1 is not, and the evidence that would justify 1 (the downstream census) has not been gathered. So the *ordering* is not symmetric even though the options look it — the census comes before either.

## What this card does NOT claim

- ⛔ Not that PR #7172 was wrong. It was reviewed and upheld; the translation is correct, complete, and cleanly revertible as one file plus its keys if answer 1 wins.
- ⛔ Not that the component is dead. It is *unrendered here*, which is a different and weaker statement.
- ⛔ Not urgent. Nothing is broken. This is a recorded asymmetry in the enforce-or-remove ledger.

## Suggested first step

File the downstream-consumer census as a seam card into `objectstack` with `repo:*` routing, exactly as objectstack#12580 was filed — the ask is one grep for `PointInTimeRestore` across `hotcrm` and `cloud`, and the answer is the whole deliverable. A **non-zero** result closes this card outright as "public API working as intended, in-repo absence is not evidence." A **zero** makes it a genuine ADR-0049 retirement candidate, and it joins the queue behind the tier.

Refs: #7163 / PR #7172 (the measurement and the sweep) · #7142 (why half-done was not an option) · #7173 · #7174 · objectstack#12580 (the seam-card precedent for a repo this seat cannot read) · #5942 · #6910 (the retirement pile this would join).
